title: Great guide and tour
text: We had an amazing time biking around the city with Alfredo.  He is an excellent guide and it was a great way to kick off our trip.  We learned a lot about the city and covered a lot of ground!  Alfredo took some great pictures for us at stops along the way.  The e-bikes were great and very comfortable.  Tour ended with a beer and patatas bravas.  Highly recommend!!
author: P885YVbethb

title: Alfredo provides a great tour
text: The passion that Alfredo has for the history of Barcelona, and strong desire to connect with the group made the tour excellent.
author: Ryan_C

title: Not to be missed!
text:
We had the most amazing time with Alfredo. We booked the e-bike tour cause we have an active 11-year old boy, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. 
Alfredo customized the route for us (we skipped Sagrada as we went there the prior day) and took a longer bike along the beach. He added so much color to the excursion by giving us a historic and cultural background of the places we visited. And then at the end treated us to a drink and an appetizer. The experience could not have been more perfect! Highly recommended!!
author: Kasia98

text: We had a fantastic experience with Alfredo cycling around Barcelona. He shared many interesting stories along the way and went out of his way to make sure we got the most out of the tour. I highly reccomend this experience.
author: M4151OQgavinm

title: Best bike tour in Barcelona
text: This was a great experience. Alfredo had some scheduling challenges and ended up doing my booking as a solo trip. He listened to my requests and I had a great tailor made experience. He is a wonderful informative guide and a really nice person. I highly recommend this tour.
author: Missy168

title: Excellent Experience!! ❤️
text: This was a terrific tour in every way. Alfredo was knowledgeable and able to show us the highlights of Barcelona. We could see that he loved his profession and his city. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: jamie_r

title: An amazing experience
text: The tour offered by Alfredo is the best way to get to know the city, on his bike route you get to visit the most important places. He explains you useful and interesting information that makes the tour more enjoyable and interesting. Besides, Alfredo takes pictures of you in the most beautiful locations. I highly recommend this activity, for me it was one of the best things of the weekend.
author: N3745YCteresaj

title: Absolutely amazing!
text: This is a must do in Barcelona and I would recommend doing at the beginning of your trip to understand the city better.  Alfredo is an amazing tour guide who is fun and so knowledgeable about the history of the city.
author: Justin P

title: EBIKE TOUR of Barcelona
text: This EBIKE TOUR was so fun!  Our guide Pablo was fantastic and took us so many places!  He guided us effortlessly through the busy streets of Barcelona and we would have never had the experience without him!  Can't recommend this highly enough!
